dv_attribution: Based on Chiaki / chiaki-ng and Android Extended. AGPLv3 with OpenSSL permission; PS5 companion: GPLv3. Independent of Sony and Nintendo.
dv_updates_intro: Checks for updates while Deckivo is open and downloads over unmetered Wi-Fi. Android may ask for installation approval. Console registrations and settings are kept.
dv_permission_denied: Permission not granted. You can keep using this version.
dv_install_permission: Allow Deckivo to install apps from this source in Android settings.
dv_no_browser: No browser is available to open this link.
dv_setup_intro: Three steps to your console. Keep both devices on the same network for setup.
dv_setup_enable: On PS5, enable Settings → System → Remote Play.
dv_profile_applied: Profile applied: H.264, no extra filters. The screen acts as a touchpad; PS and Touch are in the hidden game overlay.
dv_helper_intro: Open WebKit / Payload Manager on PS5 and wait for ELF Loader. Send the bundled companion using the button below. Enter its one-use notification code within 5 minutes. This is separate from the Remote Play PIN.
dv_setup_register: Enter Remote Play PIN and register
dv_account_required: Enter an Account ID from the companion or LinkDev (8 bytes in Base64).
dv_setup_done: After registration, return home and select PS5. Local play is ready; internet access is not configured by this version.
dv_setup_credit: Source code for this exact version is linked in Licenses and source.
dv_ip_required: Enter a private IPv4 address, such as 192.168.1.10, without http or a port.
dv_controller_intro: Test buttons and sticks on GameSir, Joy-Con or another controller.
dv_no_controller: No controller found. Connect it in Android Bluetooth settings.
dv_controller_help: Press buttons and move the sticks. PS and touchpad controls are in the hidden game overlay.
dv_layout_saved: Mapping saved. Bottom ×, right ○, left □, top △.
